title: Agent run replays: CUDA to SYCL
intro: Step through real agent-loop runs one tool call at a time: what the model said, what it called, and the evidence each tool returned. Regenerate with: python scripts/render_trace.py --site docs/replay/runs.json

runs.title: Without the toolkit: softmax ships wrong
runs.note: Ablation baseline arm: migrate, compile and file tools only, no verify. The agent compiled, said it had not run the binary, and called finish. The hidden check found 332,679 of 524,288 outputs outside tolerance.

runs.title: With the toolkit: softmax verified
runs.note: Ablation toolkit arm, same model and task: the loop only accepts compile + verify + zero dpct helpers on the current sources.

runs.title: saxpy (real run)
runs.note: Smallest example: one compile error fixed, then helper scan and verify.

runs.title: 64-tap FIR filter (real run)
runs.note: Constant-memory taps and a shared-memory tile; verify nulls the WAV output against the C++ reference below -96 dBFS.

runs.title: Fuzz waveshaper (real run)
runs.note: tanh soft-clip audio kernel; verify nulls the WAV output against the C++ reference below -96 dBFS.

runs.title: HeCBench softmax (real run)
runs.note: Cooperative-groups warp reductions ported to sub-group-size-portable SYCL.
